Specification: This module defines a very small TLA+ model containing two constant operator definitions, one string-valued and one integer-valued, plus a helper operator that adds seven to its argument. It does not declare any state variables, actions, or temporal specification, so it is not modeling a transition system or algorithm execution. The file includes a single theorem asserting that every integer in the range 1..2 is not equal to 8, and it relies on the TLC and Integers modules only through EXTENDS.
